findings.detail: BUG1 PATH-TRAVERSAL (SEVERE) confirmed CLOSED. internal/tab/sprint/handler_review.go sprintLog now (1) rejects non-clean sprintId via isCleanSegment (bars '/','\\','..' and requires filepath.Base(s)==s), and (2) gates on roadmapHasSprint (real ROADMAP match, else 404, fail-closed on read/parse error). handler.go sprintDetail got the same isCleanSegment guard before it stats logDir (defense-in-depth for the etag path; found==nil→404 already blocked reads). readFileBytes itself does NO path check, so caller guards are the control — confirmed every filesystem-path use of r.PathValue is now guarded: grep shows PathValue only at handler_review.go:344 (sprintLog, guarded) and handler.go:421 (sprintDetail, guarded); repoId/branchId go through store lookup, not paths. Regression test TestSprintLog_RejectsPathTraversal plants an out-of-tree SECRET.log at worktree root, drives the REAL handler with 5 traversal variants ('../..','../../../../var/log','..\\..','..','S_A/../..'), asserts each returns 400/404 AND never contains the secret, plus a clean-but-unknown id → 404 (proves the ROADMAP gate) and a real happy-path → 200. Pre-fix this test FAILS: sprintId='../..'+file='SECRET.log' → filepath.Join cleans to root/SECRET.log → 200 with secret leaked. Test observed PASS via `go test ./internal/tab/sprint/...`.

BUG2 PROMOTION FALSE-POSITIVE (data-correctness) confirmed CLOSED. parser/roadmap.go promotionAnchors now requires a contiguous CJK run to cover >= cjkAnchorMinFraction (0.7) of the title's TOTAL CJK runes (minRun = ceil(0.7*totalCJK), floored at 6) before it becomes a promotion anchor, so a generic shared sub-phrase (a minority of a longer title) no longer fires. §-section/ADR anchors (sectionRefRe) are untouched and still fire. Regression test TestDetectPromotion_NoFalsePositiveOnSharedCJKPhrase asserts BOTH directions: false-positive gone ('ダッシュボードの パフォーマンス改善' shares only 'パフォーマンス改善' with unrelated S_SEARCH → now '' ; pre-fix minRun=6 → anchor 'パフォーマンス改善' contained in '検索のパフォーマンス改善' → wrongly returned S_SEARCH, so test fails pre-fix), AND true promotions still fire (near-full-title '共有フォルダの宣言化' → S_SHARED ; §8.3 section ref → S_SECTION). Independently confirmed the ONE real ROADMAP promotion is NOT dropped: backlog 'GUI アプリカード (§8.3 install+folder-share 従属トグル)' carries §8.3 anchor, and sprint S41bdf2 title '§8.3 GUI アプリカードモデル…' contains '§8.3' → still detected (section anchors are unaffected by the CJK fraction change). Test observed PASS.

Backward-compat (AC-1-4): readLog fail-opens to nil on missing file → section omitted; a CORRUPT file surfaces as a per-file parser.ParseError in the response rather than crashing — this is intentional optional-artifact handling, not error-swallowing. Dead readers replaced (AC-1-3): AC matrix now derived from verification-report ac_findings + ROADMAP status; run results from verify-run.json. E2E tests/e2e/se173ef_sprint_tab.py drives these via real HTTP and asserts on the JSON (overall=pass, headings, derived matrix). All backing runs exit 0.
